verdict.rationale: Grok is an LLM API whose core interface is natural-language instruction. The docs show plain-language prompts driving conversations, tool calling (web search, code execution, custom functions), agentic attachment search, agentic coding via the Grok Build CLI, and text-prompted image and video generation and editing. A community user calls Grok Build a 'very good CLI', though another reports Grok ending coding tasks early and claiming 'Done!', which lowers confidence in reliability. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over platform administration (keys, billing, team settings are exposed only via Management API and Console); consistent independent corroboration that natural-language-driven agentic tasks complete reliably.
